automations.author: cairn
automations.blurb: Weekly board hygiene: duplicates, split candidates, stale tasks.

definition.name: Board grooming
definition.description: Reviews open tasks and suggests dedup, splits, and archiving (no auto-edits).
definition.instructions: Review the project's open tasks. Identify: tasks with very similar titles or purposes (possible duplicates), large or vague tasks that could be split into smaller ones, and stale tasks (low priority, no recent activity) that could be archived. Write a 'Board grooming — <date>' note with concrete suggestions per task (task title → suggestion). Do NOT change any tasks — recommend only.

automations.author: cairn
automations.blurb: Weekly knowledge digest: themes from recent notes and the Idea Flow.

definition.name: Knowledge digest
definition.description: Synthesises the week's notes and idea-flow nodes into a themes note.
definition.instructions: Scan the project's recent notes and Idea Flow nodes. Write a 'Knowledge digest — <date>' note with: Themes this week (2-4 bullets), Connections worth making (specific note-to-note or note-to-task links you would add, with the exact titles), and Open questions. Identify themes and propose connections — do NOT edit any notes.

automations.author: cairn
automations.blurb: A morning brief of what's overdue and due today.

definition.name: Morning brief
definition.description: Writes a short daily note of overdue tasks and tasks due today.
definition.instructions: Find overdue tasks and tasks due today in the project. Write a brief note titled 'Morning brief — <date>' listing: Overdue (soonest first, with priority), Due today, and a one-line suggested focus for the day. If nothing is overdue or due, say so in one line.

automations.author: cairn
automations.blurb: Surfaces overdue tasks with a suggested next step for each.

definition.name: Overdue nudge
definition.description: Lists overdue tasks and proposes a next step for each (no auto-edits).
definition.instructions: Find overdue tasks in the project. Write an 'Overdue — <date>' note listing them soonest-first with their priority, and for each add a one-line suggested next step (for example: reprioritise, split into smaller tasks, or drop). Do NOT modify any task — recommend only.

automations.author: cairn
automations.blurb: A project health snapshot: open work, completion, and risk.

definition.name: Project health
definition.description: Writes a project health note with completion, open work, and risks.
definition.instructions: Assess the project's health: completion rate (done vs total cards), open tasks by priority, any overdue or blocked work, and recent activity. Write (or update) a note titled 'Project health' with sections: Health (Good / At risk / Needs attention), Completion, Open work, Blocked & overdue, and Suggested focus.

automations.author: cairn
automations.blurb: A daily standup brief: in progress, done, and blocked.

definition.name: Standup brief
definition.description: Writes a short daily status note (in progress / done / blocked) for standup.
definition.instructions: Write a 'Standup — <date>' note for the project. Summarise three sections from the board: In progress (tasks currently in the in-progress column), Done (tasks completed since the previous run), and Blocked (blocked or overdue tasks). Keep each section to a few bullet lines with the task title. If a section is empty, write 'None'.

automations.author: cairn
automations.blurb: Organise recent captures: tag, link, and tidy notes.

definition.name: Tidy inbox
definition.description: Tags recent untagged notes and surfaces suggested connections.
definition.instructions: Scan the most recent notes that have no tags. For each, infer a sensible tag from the content (create the tag if needed) and apply it. If two or more notes clearly relate to each other, note the suggested link. Finish with a short summary note 'Tidy inbox — <date>' listing what was tagged and any connections found. Do not delete anything.

automations.author: cairn
automations.blurb: Summarise the week's completed work and draft a review note.

definition.name: Weekly review
definition.description: Pulls this week's Done cards and recent notes, then drafts a review note.
definition.instructions: Look at the project's board activity for this week. Summarise what was completed (Done cards), what's still open, and any patterns worth noting. Then write a concise review note titled 'Weekly review — <date>' with sections: Completed, In progress, Blocked, and Next week. Keep it tight and factual.
